description: Official state fees (gosposhlina) and charges in Uzbekistan, verified against lex.uz: company and sole-proprietor registration, trademarks and patents, court fees, licences and permits, work permits and visas, apostille, notarial acts. Returns the rate as written in the act (in BRV or %), the amount in UZS, who pays, and the legal source. These are state charges, not Pactum prices. The data is in Russian; a query in Russian matches best.

query.description: What the fee is for, e.g. "регистрация товарного знака", "court claim", "апостиль"

section.description: Limit to one section: notary, notary-private, business-registration, intellectual-property, courts, licences, migration, apostille
